API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser Authentication SettingsUpdate Auth Exempted Urls
Update Auth Exempted Urls
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/authSettings/exemptedUrls

Adds a URL to or removes a URL from the cookie authentication exempt list. To add a URL to the list, set the action parameter to ADD_TO_LIST. To remove a URL, set action to REMOVE_FROM_LIST.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
action
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [ADD_TO_LIST, REMOVE_FROM_LIST]

The action applied to the exempted URLs list (i.e., adding a URL or removing a URL).

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
urls
string[]

Domains or URLs which are exempted from SSL Inspection
